system.description:
You inscribe into your scroll the image of a Reptile with hooves and a long and stout head like a Deer, an odd mix of a Lizard and Deer infusing chakra into it as it exits your scroll into a space within range, summoning the Ink Reptile. The Ink Reptile has the listed statistics found on its stat block in the Summon Stat Blocks section.

You may command the Ink Reptile as a bonus action on your turn. The Ink Reptile may take an appropriate reaction if able, such as attack of opportunity. The Ink Bat/Snake uses your Ninjutsu Attack bonus for its attacks and your Save DC for all of its effects save DC’s.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3.
